name: 评估（满意度/效果/报告）方法

map.评估（满意度/效果/报告）方法是做什么的？: What does Event Satisfaction & Impact Assessment do?
map.如何使用评估（满意度/效果/报告）方法？: How do I use Event Satisfaction & Impact Assessment?
map.评估（满意度/效果/报告）方法适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Event Satisfaction & Impact Assessment best for?
map.体育赛事满意度与效果评估工具，计算CSAT满意度、NPS净推荐值，从多维度评估赛: A sports-event satisfaction and impact assessment tool that computes CSAT satisfaction and NPS net promoter score to evaluate event impact across multiple dimensions
map.到场率 = 实际到场人数 ÷ 总参与人数 × 100%: Attendance rate = actual attendees ÷ total participants × 100%
map.综合效果分 = (组织执行 + 场馆设施 + 宣传推广 + 安全保障) ÷ 4: Overall impact score = (organization + venue facilities + promotion + safety) ÷ 4
map.采用 CSAT 满意度调查 + NPS 净推荐值 + 效果四维评分，综合评估赛事: Uses a CSAT satisfaction survey + NPS net promoter score + a four-dimension impact rating to comprehensively assess event operation quality and offer improvement suggestions.
map.体育赛事满意度与效果评估工具，计算CSAT满意度和NPS净推荐值，从组织执行、场: A sports-event satisfaction and impact assessment tool that computes CSAT satisfaction and NPS net promoter score, evaluating event impact across organization, venue facilities, promotion, and safety.
map.📚 深度解析：赛事满意度与 NPS 评估: 📚 In-Depth: Event Satisfaction and NPS Assessment
map.赛事结束后按到场人数、满意度与推荐意愿算 CSAT 与 NPS，量化办赛效果。: After the event, compute CSAT and NPS from attendance, satisfaction, and willingness to recommend to quantify the event's impact.
map.从组织执行、场馆设施、宣传推广、安全保障四个维度打分，定位短板环节。: Rate the four dimensions — organization, venue facilities, promotion, and safety — to pinpoint weak links.
map.与往届数据对比，验证改进措施是否奏效。: Compare with previous editions to verify whether improvements worked.
map.报名 5 000、实际到场 4 200 → 到场率 84.0%。满意 3 200: Registration 5,000, actual attendance 4,200 -> attendance rate 84.0%. Satisfied 3,200 / neutral 600 / dissatisfied 400 -> CSAT = 3,200 ÷ 4,200 = 76.2% ("Good"). Promoters 2,100 / passives 1,500 / detractors 600 -> promoters 50.0%, detractors 14.3%, NPS = 35.7 ("Good"). Four-dimension ratings: organization 8 / venue 7 / promotion 6 / safety 9 -> impact score 7.5; promotion is the weakest link.
map.CSAT 和 NPS 的评级区间？: What are the CSAT and NPS rating ranges?
map.CSAT：≥85% 优秀、≥70% 良好、≥50% 一般、<50% 较差。NPS: CSAT: >=85% excellent, >=70% good, >=50% average, <50% poor. NPS: >=50 excellent, >=20 good, >=0 average, <0 a warning sign. They measure different things, so read them together.
map.到场率反映报名转化与实际组织能力。CSAT 高但到场率低，说明宣传或报名流程有问: The attendance rate reflects registration conversion and actual organizing ability. High CSAT but low attendance points to a problem in promotion or the registration process; high attendance but low CSAT points to an on-site experience problem.
map.NPS（净推荐值）=推荐者%-贬损者%，范围-100到+100: NPS (net promoter score) = promoters% − detractors%, ranging from -100 to +100
map.体育赛事参与度目标≥80%，观众满意度目标≥85%: Target event participation >= 80% and spectator satisfaction >= 85%
map.赛事效果评估应包括社会效益和经济效益双维度: Event impact assessment should cover both social and economic benefits
map.评估报告应在赛事结束后7个工作日内完成: The assessment report should be completed within 7 working days after the event
